InTotoAnnotation.description: One vendor-specific annotation on a resource descriptor, with a key and one or more values.
InTotoAnnotation.title: InTotoAnnotation

InTotoDigestSet.description: A set of digests over one artifact, keyed by algorithm, from which a consumer picks the algorithm it trusts.

dir_hash.description: A digest over a directory's content, as the in-toto framework defines it.

git_commit.description: The git commit id of a source revision.

git_tree.description: The git tree id of a source revision's content.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 digest of the artifact.

sha512.description: The SHA-512 digest of the artifact.

InTotoDigestSet.title: InTotoDigestSet

InTotoResourceDescriptor.description: A reference to a software artifact or other resource, by URI, by digest, or both, with optional metadata.

annotations.description: Vendor-specific annotations on the resource, such as the source references a Source VSA records.

digest.description: The cryptographic digests of a resource's content, keyed by algorithm.

download_location.description: Where the resource can be fetched, when that differs from its identifying URI.

media_type.description: The IANA media type of the resource's content.

resource_name.description: A name for the resource within the attestation that carries it.

resource_uri.description: The URI that identifies a resource, such as a package URL, a git repository address or an OCI image reference.

InTotoResourceDescriptor.title: InTotoResourceDescriptor

InTotoStatement.description: The statement layer of an in-toto attestation: the subjects it is about, the type of its predicate and the predicate itself.

attestation_storage_uri.description: Where the signed attestation is stored or can be fetched.

predicate.description: The predicate, one of the kinds this schema models; predicate_kind names which.

predicate_type.description: The URI that names the predicate's type and so its schema, such as https://slsa.dev/provenance/v1.

signing_tool.description: The tool that signed the attestation, named by URI, such as Cosign or Notation.

statement_type.description: The in-toto statement type, always https://in-toto.io/Statement/v1.

subject.description: The artifacts the predicate is about; each carries a digest.

transparency_log_entry.description: The transparency log entry that records the signature, such as a Rekor entry.

InTotoStatement.title: InTotoStatement

SlsaAdoptionChallenge.description: The four themes of difficulty practitioners met when adopting SLSA.
SlsaAdoptionChallenge.title: SlsaAdoptionChallenge

SlsaAdoptionMetadata.description: The adoption challenges a deployment meets and the strategies it applies, from the study's taxonomy.

strategies.description: The strategy themes applied or recommended.

SlsaAdoptionMetadata.title: SlsaAdoptionMetadata

SlsaAdoptionStrategy.description: The five themes of strategy practitioners proposed for the adoption challenges.
SlsaAdoptionStrategy.title: SlsaAdoptionStrategy

SlsaBranch.description: A named reference that moves to track a line of development.

protected.description: Whether the organization has the SCS enforce its technical controls on this reference.

reference_name.description: The reference's name, fully qualified in git, such as refs/heads/main.

reference_type.description: The kind of named reference, one of this class's descendants.

repository.description: The source repository this belongs to.

revision.description: The source revision this refers to.

SlsaBranch.title: SlsaBranch

SlsaBuildDefinition.description: The inputs to a build, in enough detail to initialize it and begin execution; the builder vouches for their accuracy.

build_type.description: The URI of the template that says how to run the build and read its parameters and dependencies; required at Build L1.

external_parameters.description: The inputs under the tenant's control; complete at Build L3 and verified by consumers.

hermetic.description: Whether the build could reach only the dependencies it declared, with no other network or filesystem access.

internal_parameters.description: The inputs the platform sets itself; kept for debugging, incident response and reproduction, and not verified by consumers.

pipeline_orchestrator.description: The CI/CD system that coordinated the build, named by URI, where it differs from the builder.

provenance_generation_tool.description: The tool that generated this provenance, named by URI.

resolved_dependencies.description: The artifacts fetched during the build, as far as the platform knows them; completeness is best effort through Build L3.

SlsaBuildDefinition.title: SlsaBuildDefinition

SlsaBuildEnvironmentAttestation.description: Evidence of the state of a build environment when a build was dispatched to it: the image it came from and the measurements taken at boot.

build_env_level.description: The SLSA Build Environment level this meets.

build_id.description: The immutable identifier of the build execution the environment was assigned to.

build_image.description: The image the environment was instantiated from.

measurements.description: The measurements of the environment's components taken during boot.

predicate_kind.description: The kind of predicate, one of this class's descendants.

SlsaBuildEnvironmentAttestation.title: SlsaBuildEnvironmentAttestation

SlsaBuildEnvironmentLevel.description: The levels of the SLSA Build Environment track, each extending integrity further into the compute that runs builds.
SlsaBuildEnvironmentLevel.title: SlsaBuildEnvironmentLevel

SlsaBuildImage.description: The template a build environment is instantiated from, such as a VM or container image: root filesystem, guest OS and packages, build executor and build agent.

build_env_level.description: The SLSA Build Environment level this meets.

image_uri.description: The URI that identifies the image version, such as an OCI reference with its digest.

produced_by.description: The party that created and distributes the image.

provenance.description: The build provenance of the image itself, required at Build Environment L1.

SlsaBuildImage.title: SlsaBuildImage

SlsaBuildImageProducer.description: The party that creates and distributes build images; the hosted build platform itself, or a third party in a bring-your-own-image setting.

party_type.description: The role the party acts in, one of this class's descendants.

SlsaBuildImageProducer.title: SlsaBuildImageProducer

SlsaBuildLevel.description: The levels of the SLSA Build track, each adding protection against tampering with the build or its provenance.
SlsaBuildLevel.title: SlsaBuildLevel

SlsaBuildMetadata.description: Metadata about one execution of a build: its identifier and when it started and finished.

invocation_id.description: An identifier for this build invocation, in a format the builder defines; useful for finding its logs.

SlsaBuildMetadata.title: SlsaBuildMetadata

SlsaBuildParameter.description: One named input to a build, with a string value.
SlsaBuildParameter.title: SlsaBuildParameter

SlsaBuildPlatform.description: The system that runs builds and records their provenance: the transitive closure of software, hardware, people and organizations trusted to do so. Provenance names it as the builder.

build_level.description: The highest SLSA Build level the platform's provenance can meet.

builder_dependencies.description: Dependencies of the platform's orchestrator that do not run inside the build but may affect provenance generation or its guarantees.

builder_id.description: The URI that identifies the platform and determines its SLSA Build level.

component_versions.description: The version of each named component of a platform.

hosted.description: Whether the platform is a hosted service on shared or dedicated infrastructure rather than an individual's workstation.

SlsaBuildPlatform.title: SlsaBuildPlatform

SlsaBuildProvenance.description: The predicate that says how a build platform produced a set of artifacts, so that consumers can verify the build met their expectations and others can rebuild it.

build_definition.description: The inputs to the build; required at Build L1.

predicate_kind.description: The kind of predicate, one of this class's descendants.

run_details.description: What is specific to this execution of the build; required at Build L1.

SlsaBuildProvenance.title: SlsaBuildProvenance

SlsaComponentVersion.description: The version of one named component of a platform.
SlsaComponentVersion.title: SlsaComponentVersion

SlsaConsumer.description: A party that uses software a producer provides, verifying its provenance itself or through a verifier.

party_type.description: The role the party acts in, one of this class's descendants.

SlsaConsumer.title: SlsaConsumer

SlsaControlPlane.description: The component of a build platform that orchestrates each build and generates its provenance, outside the tenant's control.

build_platform.description: The build platform this party or component belongs to or uses.

SlsaControlPlane.title: SlsaControlPlane

SlsaDependencyInventory.description: The inventory of every third-party build dependency, direct and transitive, of one artifact version.

artifact.description: The artifact whose dependencies are inventoried.

dependencies.description: The dependencies, each identified by URI and digest.

dependency_level.description: The SLSA Dependency level the producer's process meets for this artifact.

SlsaDependencyInventory.title: SlsaDependencyInventory

SlsaDependencyLevel.description: The levels of the SLSA Dependency track, each reducing the risk third-party dependencies bring.
SlsaDependencyLevel.title: SlsaDependencyLevel

SlsaDependencyLevelCount.description: The number of an artifact's transitive dependencies verified at one level, each counted once per track at its highest level.

dependency_count.description: How many dependencies were verified at that level.

verified_level.description: The level the dependencies were verified at.

SlsaDependencyLevelCount.title: SlsaDependencyLevelCount

SlsaDocument.description: A document that holds SLSA attestations and the parties, platforms, packages, repositories and images they concern.

adoption_metadata.description: How the deployment the document describes fares against the adoption study's themes.

parties.description: The parties, each in its role.

SlsaDocument.title: SlsaDocument

SlsaInfrastructureProvider.description: A party that provides software or services to the other roles, such as a package registry's or a build platform's maintainers.

party_type.description: The role the party acts in, one of this class's descendants.

SlsaInfrastructureProvider.title: SlsaInfrastructureProvider

SlsaMeasurement.description: The digest of one component or state of a build environment, to compare with its reference value.

digest.description: The cryptographic digests of a resource's content, keyed by algorithm.

measured_component.description: The component or state that was measured, such as the bootloader, guest kernel, build agent or root filesystem.

SlsaMeasurement.title: SlsaMeasurement

SlsaNamedReference.description: A user-friendly name for a revision in a repository, such as main or v1.2.3; reference_type says whether it is a branch or a tag.

protected.description: Whether the organization has the SCS enforce its technical controls on this reference.

reference_name.description: The reference's name, fully qualified in git, such as refs/heads/main.

reference_type.description: The kind of named reference, one of this class's descendants.

repository.description: The source repository this belongs to.

revision.description: The source revision this refers to.

SlsaNamedReference.title: SlsaNamedReference

SlsaPackage.description: A unit of software distributed under a package name, which is the primary security boundary SLSA protects. Its artifacts are the outputs of builds.

ecosystem.description: The package ecosystem whose rules govern how a package is named and distributed, such as PyPA, npm or OCI.

guac_uri.description: Where a GUAC instance answers queries about the package's dependency and provenance graph.

package_artifacts.description: The immutable artifacts the package name has resolved to.

package_name.description: The name consumers use to obtain the package within its ecosystem and registry.

registry.description: The registry the package is published to.

security_insights_uri.description: The SECURITY-INSIGHTS.yml file of the project that produces the package.

SlsaPackage.title: SlsaPackage

SlsaPackageRegistry.description: A distribution platform that resolves package names to immutable package artifacts within an ecosystem.

ecosystem.description: The package ecosystem whose rules govern how a package is named and distributed, such as PyPA, npm or OCI.

registry_uri.description: The URI that identifies the registry.

SlsaPackageRegistry.title: SlsaPackageRegistry

SlsaParty.description: A person or organization that takes part in a software supply chain, in one of the roles SLSA names.

party_type.description: The role the party acts in, one of this class's descendants.

SlsaParty.title: SlsaParty

SlsaPredicate.description: The base of every predicate this schema models; predicate_kind names the concrete kind.

predicate_kind.description: The kind of predicate, one of this class's descendants.

SlsaPredicate.title: SlsaPredicate

SlsaProducer.description: A party that creates software and provides it to others, choosing a build platform and distributing provenance.

build_platform.description: The build platform this party or component belongs to or uses.

party_type.description: The role the party acts in, one of this class's descendants.

SlsaProducer.title: SlsaProducer

SlsaResult.description: A result of evaluating an artifact against SLSA: a track level, a verified property, or a failure. A level implies the levels below it in the same track.
SlsaResult.title: SlsaResult

SlsaReviewType.description: The forms of review that may approve a revision, including the contested forms the adoption study records.
SlsaReviewType.title: SlsaReviewType

SlsaRunDetails.description: What is specific to one execution of a build: the platform that ran it, metadata about the run and its by-products.

build_metadata.description: Metadata about this execution of the build.

builder.description: The build platform that ran the build and is trusted to have written this provenance; required at Build L1.

byproducts.description: Artifacts the build produced beside its outputs that may help debugging or incident response, such as logs.

SlsaRunDetails.title: SlsaRunDetails

SlsaSourceControlSystem.description: The platform or services that host a source repository and enforce its organization's policies on authentication, authorization and change management.

scs_uri.description: The URI that identifies the source control system.

SlsaSourceControlSystem.title: SlsaSourceControlSystem

SlsaSourceLevel.description: The levels of the SLSA Source track, each adding trust in how a revision was created.
SlsaSourceLevel.title: SlsaSourceLevel

SlsaSourceProvenance.description: Evidence from an SCS of how a revision came to exist and which technical controls were enforced when it did.

controls_enforced.description: The technical controls the SCS enforced when the revision was created, as the organization documents them.

predicate_kind.description: The kind of predicate, one of this class's descendants.

revision.description: The source revision this refers to.

SlsaSourceProvenance.title: SlsaSourceProvenance

SlsaSourceRepository.description: A self-contained unit that holds a set of files, their revision history and metadata such as branches and tags.

hosted_by.description: The source control system that hosts the repository.

repository_uri.description: The stable locator the SCS gives the repository.

SlsaSourceRepository.title: SlsaSourceRepository

SlsaSourceRevision.description: A logically immutable snapshot of a repository's tracked files, with its version-control metadata: author, time and parent revisions.

authored_by.description: The identity of the person or automation that authored the revision.

parent_revisions.description: The revisions this one descends from, which together form the change history.

repository.description: The source repository this belongs to.

review_type.description: The form of review that approved the revision.

revision_id.description: The revision identifier the SCS assigns, such as a git commit id or a path- qualified sequence number.

source_level.description: The SLSA Source level the SCS asserts for the revision.

SlsaSourceRevision.title: SlsaSourceRevision

SlsaTag.description: A named reference meant never to move once created.

protected.description: Whether the organization has the SCS enforce its technical controls on this reference.

reference_name.description: The reference's name, fully qualified in git, such as refs/heads/main.

reference_type.description: The kind of named reference, one of this class's descendants.

repository.description: The source repository this belongs to.

revision.description: The source revision this refers to.

SlsaTag.title: SlsaTag

SlsaVerificationResult.description: The outcome of verifying an artifact against a policy.
SlsaVerificationResult.title: SlsaVerificationResult

SlsaVerificationSummary.description: The predicate in which a verifier records that it evaluated artifacts against a policy and the SLSA levels they met, so consumers can rely on the verifier instead of reading every underlying attestation.

dependency_levels.description: How many transitive dependencies were verified at each level; absent when the verifier makes no claim about dependencies.

input_attestations.description: Every attestation the verifier consulted, each with a digest; complete when present.

organization_properties.description: Properties an organization defines for its own consumers, each prefixed ORG_SOURCE_.

policy.description: The policy the subject was verified against, by URI and preferably by digest too.

predicate_kind.description: The kind of predicate, one of this class's descendants.

resource_uri.description: The URI consumers fetch the artifact from, which the verifier verified it as.

slsa_version.description: The SLSA specification version the verifier applied, as MAJOR.MINOR.

verification_result.description: Whether the subject passed the policy.

verified_levels.description: The highest level verified in each track, and any verified property; a level implies the levels below it.

verifier.description: The verifier that made this determination.

SlsaVerificationSummary.title: SlsaVerificationSummary

SlsaVerifier.description: A party that inspects provenance or other attestations and decides whether an artifact is authentic.

component_versions.description: The version of each named component of a platform.

party_type.description: The role the party acts in, one of this class's descendants.

verifier_id.description: The URI that identifies the verifier.

SlsaVerifier.title: SlsaVerifier

description: A document that holds SLSA attestations and the parties, platforms, packages, repositories and images they concern.

adoption_metadata.description: How the deployment the document describes fares against the adoption study's themes.

parties.description: The parties, each in its role.
